dashboard.quickActionsHint: Shortcuts to the screens you use most.

platform.tenantsSubtitle: Aggregate cross-tenant listing without per-record PII. Provisioning, suspension and reinstatement run from one screen.
platform.provisionHint: Single transaction: a failure halfway leaves zero rows (AC-PLT-1). The Idempotency-Key header is generated automatically and reused until the request succeeds.
platform.reasonPlaceholder: At least 10 characters — this reason is stored in the audit trail.
platform.slugHint: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only
platform.detailEmpty: Pick a row to inspect modules, roles and subscription.
platform.transitionHint: The status column is SERVER_ONLY — it only changes through the transition routes, with a reason and an MFA session.
platform.loadError: Failed to load the institution list.
platform.mfaRequired: Platform writes require an MFA session. Sign in again and complete the TOTP challenge.
platform.forbidden: Rejected by the server (403) — insufficient permission for this action.
platform.conflict: Conflict — the slug/email may already exist, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload.
platform.auditSubtitle: Reading another tenant's trail requires a reason, and this read itself becomes a new audit row in the operator tenant.
platform.auditIdle: No query run yet — choose an institution and provide a reason.
platform.auditNoRows: No audit rows in this range or filter.
platform.chainNote: Hashes are chained with SHA-256 per tenant. Verify the chain with `pnpm --filter @sica/web verify:chain`.
platform.writeOnRead: This read itself has been recorded as a new audit row in the operator tenant.
platform.supportSubtitle: Support grants have a TTL of at most 30 minutes, require MFA, and are recorded as an audit row in the target tenant.
platform.targetTenantHint: Provide the target slug OR id — the slug takes priority when both are filled.
platform.sessionLedgerTitle: Grants created in this browser session

security.title: How SICA plans to protect information

items.title: Separate campus data
items.desc: Each campus's information is planned to be stored separately. This separation must be tested before use.

items.title: Access based on work
items.desc: Users should only see or change information needed for their work. This rule still needs testing.

items.title: Account security
items.desc: Passwords and sign-in details must be protected before the portal is used.

items.title: Change records
items.desc: Important changes are planned to be recorded so they can be reviewed later.

items.title: Limited access
items.desc: Access should match each person's campus responsibilities and must be checked before use.

items.title: Privacy
items.desc: Personal information should only be collected when needed, protected and kept according to applicable rules.

security.note: These are security plans, not a certificate or a guarantee that every protection is active.

admin.usersSubtitle: Accounts, memberships and effective roles read from assignments — not the login label.
admin.createHint: A new account deliberately holds no permission until a second person approves a grant.
admin.memberCodeHint: Student / lecturer ID — unique inside this institution
admin.carrierHint: Routes the login only; it is not an access right
admin.passwordHint: At least 12 characters; shown once and never logged
admin.reasonHint: At least 10 characters — the reason is evidence, not a formality
admin.roleHint: System roles can be assigned but their composition stays locked
admin.userCreatedBody: account active with zero rights; request a role from the access tab
admin.deactivateBody: Account status closes, every assignment gets valid_to, active sessions are revoked. The user row stays so academic history remains readable.
admin.requestQueuedBody: The right is not active yet — another approver must confirm it in the requests queue
admin.grantPendingNote: Four-eyes: you cannot approve your own request, and an approver cannot approve a grant to themselves.
admin.rbacSubtitle: Role × permission × assignment matrix; every rights change goes through two people.
admin.systemLockedBody: A system role’s composition cannot be edited; create a custom role when the campus needs something different.
admin.searchPermissionHint: Type at least 2 characters, e.g. finance.invoice
admin.noSearchResults: No new permission matches the search.
admin.previewNote: This list is a preview of the request. The role’s permission count has not changed until someone approves.
admin.revokeQueuedBody: The assignment is not revoked yet; the REVOKE request awaits a second approver. Rows are never deleted.
admin.deltaQueuedBody: The permission delta is not active; role_permissions changes only after approval.
admin.requestsSubtitle: GRANT · REVOKE · ROLE_PERMISSION_CHANGE in one four-eyes decision queue.
admin.approved: Approved — the right applies from the next request
admin.decisionHint: Decisions are terminal and recorded in the audit chain together with the approver’s identity.
admin.rejectHint: Required, ≥ 10 characters: an unexplained rejection cannot be audited
admin.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded: {message}
admin.fourEyesBody: Approval refuses when the approver is the requester or the target, requires an MFA session, and refuses any scope wider than the approver’s own assignment.

org.title: Organization & Study Programs
org.subtitle: The ground assignment scopes stand on: faculties, departments, units and study programs with their academic numbers.
org.hintCode: Optional; when set it is unique within this institution
org.hintPddikti: Used by the Feeder submission channel; empty means this program is never submitted
org.hintNumbers: These academic numbers decide study load and graduation — every change is recorded with a reason.
org.saved: Change saved and recorded in the audit trail.
org.noOrgs: No organizations yet. Add a hierarchy root first (e.g. the rectorate or a graduate school).
org.noProdis: No study programs yet. A program must point to the organization it belongs to.
org.cycleBlocked: The hierarchy must not loop — the new parent sits below this node itself.
org.note: There is no delete button. Organizations and programs are reference points for scopes and historical reports; deleting them breaks records already published.

admin.statusFilterNote: Decided rows stay visible: a terminal decision is evidence, not queue litter.

list.title: System Parameters
list.description: Thresholds, limits, flags and patterns read by the engine — one home per institution.

disabled.notParamSource: The real value lives in another home and is maintained there.
disabled.noEditGrant: You do not hold the write grant for this class.
disabled.checkLocked: Enforced by a database CHECK — no screen can negotiate past it.
disabled.moduleInactive: The owning module is not active for this institution.

range.pctHint: The 100% ceiling is enforced in transport and in the database.
range.cronPreview: Schedule preview appears once the scheduler reads this key.
range.cronPreviewUnavailable: Preview unavailable; the server still validates the value.

riskCopy.totpRotate: A shorter rotation window shrinks the time a token can be replayed. Values below 5 seconds are rejected by the database and cannot be saved from any screen.
riskCopy.geofenceRadius: A looser radius rejects fewer legitimate scans but widens the chance of recording attendance outside the room. Per-room limits stay in rooms.allowed_radius_m.
riskCopy.gpsAccuracy: A tighter accuracy threshold will reject more legitimate readings inside the building.
riskCopy.clockSkew: A looser clock skew accepts events that did not happen now.
riskCopy.onlineMinJoin: Lowering the ratio counts partial attendance as fully present.
riskCopy.multiSourcePolicy: This policy decides which evidence wins when on-site and online disagree; attendance stays one row per (session, student).

pending.effective: The old value stays effective until this request is approved.
pending.selfApprovalNotice: You cannot approve your own request (SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN).

error.outOfRange: Value outside the allowed range. Resubmit between the lower and upper bounds shown.
error.readOnly: This key is a discovery index only. Open the screen that owns the value.
error.invalidType: Value type does not match the key data_type. The control label states the expected shape.
error.enumUnknown: Value is not a dictionary member on that date. Add the dictionary item first; do not force the number.
error.secretForbidden: Parameters never store secrets. Move the credential to ENV/vault.
error.restartRequired: This key needs a release. The value was not written because the deploy pipeline is not wired.
error.approvalRequired: Value stored as a draft and not yet effective. Send it to a second approver.
error.patternInvalid: Invalid grant pattern. Check the parameterPattern shape and the required note.
error.permissionUnknown: Permission code is not in the catalog. Names cannot be invented from a screen.
error.conflictVersion: The row changed since you loaded it. Reload before saving.
error.selfApproval: Four-eyes: the approver must be a second person. Ask another class holder to decide.
error.alreadyDecided: Request already in a terminal state. See this key’s history.
error.notFound: Key not found in this institution.

mfa.gate: Changes of class {riskClass} require a multi-factor session. Your input stays on this screen until verification completes.

sod.grantHolder: Save is hidden because your grants do not cover this class — submitting is still possible.
sod.securityClass: You hold grants over the object this threshold guards. The change must be submitted by another admin and approved by a second person (SoD G-19).

stale.title: Version state changed
stale.detail: The row is no longer version {version}. Saving would silently overwrite someone else’s change.

mode.readonlyReconstruct: Read-only mode: state reconstructed from history on {at}. No value can be changed.
mode.clientNotice: Numbers on this screen are server projections. Clients never decide from editable thresholds.

history.title: Change history
history.empty: No recorded change in this range.
history.redactedNotice: Full identity and IP address are shown only to history-view holders.
history.replicaLag: History read from a read replica; newest entries may lag briefly.
history.revertConfirm: Value {from} becomes {to}. This writes a new entry, never deletes a trace.

impact.title: Impact
impact.empty: No registry row for this key — nothing reads it.
impact.orphan: Key without a registered consumer (CI debt, not a feature).
impact.openingLine: What this change touches: every reader below sees the new value on its next request.

register.title: Register a new key
register.consumerHint: Call sites that already exist in this branch (file:symbol), comma separated. Without consumers registration is rejected.
register.dataTypeUnit: The type decides the control; the unit is appended to the current value.
register.riskClassHint: REGULATORY/SECURITY keys cannot be registered from a screen: the CHECK demands a real second approver.

queue.title: Approval queue
queue.reasonRequired: Rejection requires a reason of 10–500 characters.

krs.metaDescription: Build this semester's study plan from the real class list: IPS-based SKS ceiling, seat capacity, and schedule clashes.
krs.title: Study Plan Card (KRS)
krs.description: Build this semester's study plan: mind the IPS-based SKS ceiling, seat capacity, and schedule clashes before submitting to your academic adviser.
krs.noStudentTitle: This account is not linked to a student profile
krs.noStudentBody: The class list and SKS ceiling are computed from student rows in this institution. Contact the academic office to link the account; this screen never shows estimated classes.
krs.noPeriodBody: This institution has no academic period, so there are no open classes to display.
krs.notYourAreaTitle: This screen is not your area
krs.notYourAreaBody: Taking seats and submitting a KRS is held only by roles granted enrollment.krs.submit. You do not hold it, so this screen renders no action button at all.
krs.noDataNoAction: No period or student profile could be read, so no class is displayed and no action is offered.
krs.plafonHint: Computed from the previous period's IPS and the study programme's cap (BR-A2)
krs.enrolledSubtitle: Real enrollment rows in the active period. Releasing a seat is not an action of this screen (permission enrollment.krs.withdraw).
krs.enrolledHint: Cannot be released from this screen
krs.quotaBlockedTitle: KRS entry held by the validator
krs.degradedBody: This screen loaded {shown} of {total} open classes in the period. Narrow the filter or use the API to see the rest.
krs.gridSubtitle: Seat capacity is counted from active enrollments. Full or clashing classes cannot be taken.
krs.searchPlaceholder: Search code, course, class, or lecturer...
krs.reasonTaken: This seat is already part of your enrollment in this period.
krs.reasonPeriodClosed: Period {period} has status {status} — entry is closed.
krs.reasonClassClosed: The class has been closed by the study programme.
krs.reasonConflict: Schedule clashes with your own class: {detail}
krs.reasonQuota: Taking this class exceeds the {max} SKS ceiling.
krs.reasonMaxClasses: A maximum of {max} classes per submission.
krs.periodClosedHint: The KRS entry period is closed
krs.quotaAlertBody: Your plan totals {total} SKS while this semester's ceiling is {max} SKS. Reduce {over} SKS by releasing one class.
krs.conflictBlocked: {count} class pair(s) have clashing schedules. Release one of the clashing classes before submitting.
krs.releaseHint: Release the seat from your study plan
krs.selectionLabel: Select classes for the study plan
krs.sentBody: {count} class(es) were submitted to your academic adviser (DPA) and await approval.
krs.sentAlready: {count} class(es) were already in your study plan (idempotent).
krs.networkFailed: The submission was not sent because of a network problem. Reload and submit again.
krs.readOnlyTitle: Read-only: you do not hold the KRS submit action
krs.readOnlyBody: The list below is this period's real class offering, shown without seat-taking affordances because that action belongs to holders of the enrollment.krs.submit permission.
krs.emptyTitle: No open class in this period yet
krs.emptyBody: The study programme has not published any OPEN class for the selected period, or the open classes belong to another study programme.
krs.reloadAria: Reload KRS data from the server
krs.reloadHint: Fetch classes, quota, and enrollments again from the database
krs.seatsFullNote: Class full — a seat opens only when a student withdraws.
krs.detailHowBody: Seats are taken when the submission is sent, then approved by the adviser. Status, SKS quota, and schedule clashes are revalidated on the server — this screen only warns in advance.

app.topbarAria: Top bar: brand, search and account
app.searchPlaceholder: Search courses, lecturers, or student ID…

designPanel.title: Appearance panel
designPanel.description: Works like the theme customizer: it changes the layout and colours of this screen.
